children: BTC Development reported net income for the quarter, compared with a loss a year earlier, as $2.37 million of interest earned on Trust Account securities more than offset $366,994 in formation, general and administrative costs. The company said it has not begun operations and does not expect operating revenue before completing a business combination.
: Securities held in the account totaled $261.9 million at September 30, 2026, including $6.9 million of interest income.
: The company continued identifying a target; it intends to use substantially all Trust Account funds toward a business combination.
: Cash outside the Trust Account was $834,387, and management said liquidity conditions raise substantial doubt about the company’s ability to continue as a going concern.
